firstPlayerRule: Decide who goes first by rolling the dice. Players then take turns clockwise.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest roll, those players roll again.
interpretation: The rules say to decide by rolling the dice without naming high or low; this site treats the highest roll as going first.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Ravensburger-hosted rules PDF, which is a scan with no text layer, rendered its pages to images and read them. PDF page 2: "5. Decide by rolling the dice who goes first." "Playing the Game: Players take their turns clockwise. Both dice are thrown at each turn." Ravensburger Games no. 01 148 3, by Alex Randolph and Michel Matschoss.
uncertainty: The rules do not say whether high or low wins the roll; this site reads it as the highest roll.
